question: Calculate the average pick percentage for each product name, using a first-in-first-out approach that selects from inventory locations based on the earliest purchase date and smallest available quantity, ensuring that the picked quantity reflects only the overlapping range between each order’s required quantity and the inventory’s available quantity, and then grouping and ordering the results by product name?
sql:
-- Final query: average pick percentage per product name using FIFO allocation
WITH ord_lines AS (
    SELECT ol.id, ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.qty as order_qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered ASC, ol.id ASC) as order_rank
    FROM orderlines ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.id
),
inv_info AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) as total_inv
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY product_id
),
cum_ordered AS (
    SELECT ol.product_id, ol.order_rank, ol.order_qty,
           SUM(ol.order_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY ol.order_rank ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as cum_ordered
    FROM ord_lines ol
),
order_pick AS (
    SELECT co.product_id, co.order_rank, co.order_qty,
           ii.total_inv,
           LEAST(co.order_qty, GREATEST(0, ii.total_inv - (co.cum_ordered - co.order_qty))) as allocated,
           CASE WHEN co.order_qty > 0 THEN 1.0 * LEAST(co.order_qty, GREATEST(0, ii.total_inv - (co.cum_ordered - co.order_qty))) / co.order_qty ELSE 0 END as pick_pct
    FROM cum_ordered co
    JOIN inv_info ii ON co.product_id = ii.product_id
)
SELECT p.name as product_name,
       AVG(op.pick_pct) as avg_pick_pct
FROM order_pick op
JOIN products p ON op.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY p.name

-- Final query: average pick percentage per product name using FIFO allocation
WITH ord_lines AS (
    SELECT ol.id, ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.qty as order_qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered ASC, ol.id ASC) as order_rank
    FROM orderlines ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.id
),
inv_info AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) as total_inv
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY product_id
),
cum_ordered AS (
    SELECT ol.product_id, ol.order_rank, ol.order_qty,
           SUM(ol.order_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY ol.order_rank ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as cum_ordered
    FROM ord_lines ol
),
order_pick AS (
    SELECT co.product_id, co.order_rank, co.order_qty,
           ii.total_inv,
           LEAST(co.order_qty, GREATEST(0, ii.total_inv - (co.cum_ordered - co.order_qty))) as allocated,
           CASE WHEN co.order_qty > 0 THEN 1.0 * LEAST(co.order_qty, GREATEST(0, ii.total_inv - (co.cum_ordered - co.order_qty))) / co.order_qty ELSE 0 END as pick_pct
    FROM cum_ordered co
    JOIN inv_info ii ON co.product_id = ii.product_id
)
SELECT p.name as product_name,
       AVG(op.pick_pct) as avg_pick_pct
FROM order_pick op
JOIN products p ON op.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY p.name
